gate_criteria.criterion: interrupted writes cannot invent completed samples
gate_criteria.evidence: A truncated final line, an unparsable line, a schema-invalid line, a missing payload and a tampered payload are each reported as Damage and withheld from the event stream. tests/integration/test_storage_recovery.py produces the crash scenario by actually SIGKILLing a writer subprocess mid-append and asserts every surviving completion event still has a verifiable payload. The durability ordering (payload fsync+atomic rename before the event line is appended) is asserted directly.

gate_criteria.criterion: redacted exports contain no canary secrets
gate_criteria.evidence: Redaction happens before the payload is written, so the log itself is clean. Recognizable canaries (sk-, ghp_, AIza, AKIA, JWT, PEM, 'api_key=' forms) and environment-sourced secrets are replaced with [REDACTED]. Credential-named headers are always redacted regardless of content. test_g02_gate.py asserts no canary survives the events file, the JSON export or the CSV export. Redaction is proven idempotent and proven not to damage hashes, versions or counts. CSV cells starting = + - @ are defused.

gate_criteria.criterion: replaying saved generations does not contact a provider
gate_criteria.evidence: ReplayReader is constructed from paths only and exposes no client, transport, session or credential attribute. The module imports no http/requests/socket/urllib, asserted by AST inspection in two tests. Replay is exercised with credentials set and the autouse socket guard active. Strict replay refuses to reconstruct from a damaged store rather than returning a partial result.
